coachBetBody: Tap a chip, then DEAL. This table starts at {min} per hand.
coachNpcBody: Practice bots play first. Your turn begins when HIT and STAND become available.
coachPlayBody: Get closer to 21 than the dealer without going over. HIT adds a card; STAND ends your turn. Over 21 loses.
coachSettleBody: Your result shows your bet, hand return and any sweep pot separately. Continue when ready.
coachDealerBody: The dealer draws below 17 and stands on all 17s. Look at the visible dealer card before choosing your move.
coachPushBody: An equal total is a push: your bet returns. Going over 21 loses, even if the dealer also busts.
coachPotBody: Losing bets from other seats form the sweep pot. Beat the dealer with the best remaining total (ties count) to take it.
coachMovesBody: DOUBLE adds an equal bet and one card. SPLIT separates a pair with another bet. SURRENDER returns half your opening bet.
coachDoneBody: You have finished the three coached hands. Reopen the rules or replay the tutorial from Settings anytime.
coachInsuranceBody: Insurance costs half your bet and pays 2:1 only if the dealer has blackjack. You can decline.
guideCardsBody: Number cards keep their value. J, Q and K count 10. An Ace counts 1 or 11, whichever keeps the hand at 21 or below.
guidePayoutsBody: A win pays 1:1, natural blackjack pays 3:2, a push returns your bet, and surrender returns half. A dealer blackjack beats any non-natural 21.
guideChipsBody: Table limits appear in the lobby. Rebuy and daily bonuses have cooldowns; check the chip options when your balance is low.
lobbyHeadsUpNote: You vs the dealer · no sweep pot
guideRoomsBody: Bronze, Silver and VIP seat you with four other players and play for the sweep pot. The Trio table seats you with two, still with a sweep pot. Heads-Up is you against the dealer alone, with no sweep pot. At every table with other seats you act last, just before the dealer.
turnTimerSublabel: Stand automatically after 20 seconds, like a real table
feltDealerWaits: The dealer waits for every seat
dealerRule: The dealer draws to 16 and stands on all 17s.
comebackSublabel: On a losing streak or low on chips, the game may deal you a stronger starting hand. Turn it off for a straight deal from the shuffled deck.
guideComebackBody: Comeback Boost: when you are low on chips or have lost two hands in a row, the game may deal your first two cards as the best of three tries, a stronger starting hand. It only affects your opening two cards, and you can turn it off in Settings for a straight deal.

analyticsSublabelForm: On unless you opt out. Where you are (the EU, UK or Switzerland) Google's consent form decides: tap to review or change your answer. Counts of hands played and screens opened, and crash reports, go to Google Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics, along with the game's own install and error records. Never your name, group code or chat. It does not cover your leaderboard record.
analyticsSublabel: On unless you turn it off. Counts of hands played and screens opened, and crash reports, go to Google Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics so problems can be found and fixed, along with the game's own install and error records. Never your name, group code or chat. It does not cover your leaderboard record.

deleteAccountSublabel: Remove your online account and records
deleteAccountBody: This permanently deletes your online account and its records: your leaderboard entry, your name and your place in any friends group. Other players' data is not touched. Your chips, stats and settings on this phone are kept, and a Google sign-in asks you to confirm first. Your Google account itself is not affected. The game starts a new anonymous guest account, with a new leaderboard record, the next time it opens. If the game cannot confirm the result it says so, and running this again is safe. This cannot be undone.
